Name: Wordament Snap Attack
Description: A Wordament spin-off that turns a photographed grid of letters into a puzzle to solve against the clock.

Achievements.Name: First Snap
Achievements.Description: Make a Snap. Place your tiles on the board to make words.

Achievements.Name: Snap Snap
Achievements.Description: Create a Multi-Snap. Multi Snaps use at least 2 words

Achievements.Name: Recall
Achievements.Description: Make a snap, recall your tiles and make a new snap

Achievements.Name: Double Double
Achievements.Description: Use the same bonus tile twice in one snap

Achievements.Name: CH a CH ING
Achievements.Description: Make a snap using a multi-letter tile

Achievements.Name: Multilingual
Achievements.Description: Play Snap Attack in more than one language

Achievements.Name: Bingo
Achievements.Description: Play all seven tiles in a Single-Snap

Achievements.Name: Lucky Seven
Achievements.Description: Play all seven tiles in a Multi-Snap

Achievements.Name: Trifecta
Achievements.Description: Play the same Single-Snap in three different ways

Achievements.Name: Get in shape
Achievements.Description: Make a snap in each of the following shapes

Achievements.Name: Simul-Snap
Achievements.Description: By moving a single tile, create multiple independent snaps

Achievements.Name: Swap Snap
Achievements.Description: Tap 2 tiles to swap them and make a new snap

Achievements.Name: World Champ
Achievements.Description: Place in the top 250 players in any of the “Top Player” leaderboards
